title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale, with a perfect orientation, at Palati Me Shjeta!!
description_en: At Palace with Arrows, in front of Delijorgji Complex, on Bajram Curri Boulevard, 1+1 Apartment for Sale, with Perfect Location and Orientation!!! The apartment is located on the seventh residential floor of a new building, with an elevator and well managed. The apartment has a gross area of ​​53 m2 and a net area of ​​47 m2. The organization of the apartment begins with the corridor that divides the living room together with the dining and cooking area with access to the balcony, a bedroom with access to the balcony and a toilet. Orientation from the South-West makes this light throughout the day. The apartment has just been fully invested by the owner, starting from the multi-layer hydraulic system, flush toilet, electrical system, doors, thermal double-glazed plastic windows, AC5 parquet, patination, etc. The area offers many facilities starting from the perfect location and for this reason it is a very good opportunity both for living and for investment since the rents are very high in that area. It has full mortgage documentation.
